versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message: Removed deprecated SNOMED concept 618546 'Neisseria gonorrhoeae subspecies kochii' (invalid in OMOP, reclassified). Its replacement 4034609 'Neisseria kochii' was already present in the set, so resolution is unchanged.

versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message: Anchor the expression on the SNOMED 'Gram-negative bacterium' concept (81325006) with descendants, replacing the flat list of ~8700 organisms. Captures the same organisms plus newer descendants; robust to future SNOMED additions. Renamed subcategory to Bacteria.

versions.author: Boris Delange
versions.message: Deprecated: the 'any Gram-negative bacterium' set (SNOMED organism hierarchy, ~8900 organisms) duplicates the species-specific sets and is not a protocol variable; Gram stain results are covered by set 240.
